collections.name: LAB LEADER TOOLKIT
collections.tagline: Everything a CDSI lab leader needs to run a great debate class — reference material for the room, projection tools for reset moments, and playbooks for the adults in the front.

collections.name: DEBATER RESOURCES
collections.tagline: Reference material and study tools for policy debate students — search terms, review the slides from class, and grab worksheets for practice.

tools.title: TEACHER MOVES
tools.description: Twelve teacher moves framed as quest mechanics — for lab leaders who've never run a classroom before.

tools.title: BRAIN BREAKS
tools.description: Spin the wheel for a two-minute activity to reset the room mid-lesson. 24 activities from the CDSI curriculum.
tools.meta: Project on the board · 12 per spin

tools.title: JEOPARDY GAMES
tools.description: Projector-friendly hub of Jeopardy-style review games. One click to project — every game opens in a new tab so the hub stays open for the next one.

tools.title: MISSIONS
tools.description: Interactive missions with rank progression — sign in to save your progress and level up as you play.

tools.title: PREVIEW MISSIONS
tools.description: See what your students see — open the debater Bridge to browse the mission path before class.

tools.title: LESSONS
tools.description: Review the slides from class and download the graphic organizer for each lesson — nine lessons, one page.

tools.title: ROUND PLAYBOOK
tools.description: Interactive timeline of every speech in a policy round — your mission, what to say to the judge, and one pro move per speech. Hover any debate term for a definition.

tools.title: GLOSSARY
tools.description: Every policy debate term a novice will meet, with plain-English definitions and links to related concepts.
